fields.description: Marbella is Bloom Living’s tenth release, offering three- to six-bedroom villas. Two mirrored design types pair ground-floor living spaces with upstairs bedrooms and family rooms, with lake or park settings depending on the plot.

sources.label: Bloom · subsequent Malaga launch, historical Marbella sell-out reference
Bloom · Marbella original brochure and eight villa plans
Bloom Living · shared community location and amenities

overview: The developer’s subsequent Malaga announcement described Marbella as sold out in record time. Current three- and four-bedroom unit pages also carry sold-out labels; confirm availability for any selected home.
research.locationNote: Bloom Living, Zayed City, Abu Dhabi.
research.priceNote: The launch advertised AED 3.8m. Current 5BR and 6BR pages publish AED 6.765m and AED 8.397m respectively; 3BR and 4BR pages are marked sold out. These are guides, not verified available units.
research.paymentNote: Published developer terms: 5% booking, 45% construction, 50% handover. A dated selected-unit calendar was not retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Q4 2028 is the developer’s published completion target, corroborated by Property Finder; it is not evidence of actual delivery.

facts.value: Brochure illustrates premium and upgrade finishes; confirm the contracted package.
